input: Take a sushi rolling class this weekend

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's city or neighbourhood determines which classes are physically reachable, or whether an online class is the only viable option.
Whether this is a solo activity, a date, a group outing, or a family event changes the type of class to look for and how many spots to book.
Sushi rolling classes range from beginner-friendly intro sessions to more advanced styles (e.g. nigiri, specialty rolls); knowing the skill level shapes which class fits.
Budget per person varies widely across classes — a price ceiling rules in or out entire categories of providers.
In-person vs. virtual, and which specific day (Saturday vs. Sunday) affect availability and what the immediate booking action looks like.
Some people care about the social/fun atmosphere, others about the quality of instruction or the ingredients used — this shapes which class to prioritise.
Knowing what 'done well' means — e.g. leaving with a replicable skill vs. just having a fun experience — determines how to evaluate options before booking.

gold.taskTitle: Take a sushi rolling class this weekend
gold.taskDescription: Find and attend a sushi rolling class happening this weekend.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the location to search for nearby in-person classes, or confirms if online is preferred.

questions.title: Will you be attending solo or bringing others?
questions.description: Determines how many spots need to be booked and whether a private or group class suits better.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or have you rolled before?
questions.description: Matches the class difficulty level to the user's existing experience with sushi making.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the class?
questions.description: Sets a price ceiling to filter out classes that are too expensive or identify free/low-cost options.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person, or would a virtual class work?
questions.description: Determines the format of the class, which directly affects availability and the booking process.

questions.title: Is the vibe more important than the instruction quality?
questions.description: Clarifies whether a fun, social atmosphere or rigorous hands-on teaching is the higher priority when choosing.

questions.title: What would make this class feel worth it to you?
questions.description: Defines the personal success criteria — e.g. a repeatable skill, a great experience, impressing someone — to guide the final choice.
